🔺 **F-2329-1 OPEN — OWNER (s2329 2026-08-26): A VERIFIED, LIVE DEPLOY IS RECORDED AS `interrupted` IN THE ONLY MACHINE-READABLE CHANNEL, AND THE ASSAYER LEG DIED SILENTLY INSIDE IT — SO THE ENGINE/ASSAYER SKEW F-2296-1 NAMES MAY BE LIVE RIGHT NOW.** Measured LOCAL and READ-ONLY on a dry board: no ssh to production, nothing deployed, no credential value read. 📊 **THE TWO CHANNELS DISAGREE, AND ONLY ONE IS MACHINE-READABLE.** `logs/deploy.log` records `08:40:24 DEPLOYED ok https://655390f8.gold-rush-3in.pages.dev`, then `08:40:26 VERIFY attempt 1/7: … says ccedf620`, then `08:40:26 VERIFIED published ccedf620 at https://gold-rush-3in.pages.dev` — that is s2327’s handoff commit `ccedf6200`, live and confirmed against the production alias. `logs/deploy-result.json` records `{"outcome":"interrupted","url":"","publishedBuild":"ccedf620","commit":"ccedf6200…","ts":"2026-08-26T01:43:06Z"}`. ⏱️ **The timestamps are in DIFFERENT ZONES and both are correct, which is why this is easy to misread: the result file writes true UTC (`date -u`, `deploy.sh:19`) while the log writes local (`date '+%F %T'`, `:14`), so `01:43:06Z` IS `08:43:06+07` — i.e. the `interrupted` verdict was written 2m40s AFTER the deploy was verified live.** 🕳️ **THE RUN DIED INSIDE THE ASSAYER LEG, PROVEN BY ABSENCE: the log ENDS at the VERIFIED line, and NONE of the leg’s three declarations appear — `ASSAYER SYNCED` (`deploy.sh:177`), `ASSAYER SYNC FAILED mid-step` (`:179`), `ASSAYER NOT SYNCED (box unreachable)` (`:182`).** The leg is entered at `:174` and the success path exits at `finish deployed 0` (`:184`), so the process was killed between those two lines; the traps at `:43`–`:45` (`HUP`/`INT`/`TERM` → `finish interrupted`) are what wrote a result file at all, and they emit no `note`, so the log gets nothing. ✅ **SAME-DAY INTERNAL CONTROL, SAME BOX, SAME LEG, 100 MINUTES EARLIER — so this is a divergence from a proven baseline, not an untested path: `07:00:14 DEPLOYED ok` → `07:00:15 VERIFIED published d4458867` → `07:00:31 ASSAYER SYNCED: droplet tree + pin d4458867, services restarted`. The leg completed in SIXTEEN SECONDS and the box was reachable that morning.** ⚖️ **SEVERITY STATED HONESTLY AND DELIBERATELY NOT INFLATED — THE PLAYER-FACING DEPLOY SUCCEEDED. `ccedf620` is verified live at the production alias; NOTHING IS BROKEN FOR THE PLAYER and this row must not be read as a failed deploy.** What is wrong is the RECORD and the ASSAYER half. (1) **The record: `outcome:"interrupted"` is TRUE about the script’s exit and FALSE about the deploy’s outcome, and the file is structurally unable to tell the two apart** — "interrupted BEFORE publishing" and "interrupted AFTER a verified publish" write the IDENTICAL `outcome`, both with `url:""`; the distinction survives only in the human-readable log, which no tool reads. (2) **The assayer: the last CONFIRMED pin is `d4458867` (07:00) while Pages now serves `ccedf620`.** If the 08:40 rsync did not complete, the droplet is pinned one build behind the live engine — which is EXACTLY the condition F-HEAT6-SKEW built this leg to prevent (the comment at `:165`–`:168`: *"a deploy that moves the game engine but not the assayer’s tree makes every fresh tape honestly unassayable"*) and re-creates the state 🔺 **F-2296-1** is already open about. ⚠️ **And `:175`’s rsync carries `--delete`, so an interrupted sync can leave a MIXED tree — the state `:179`’s message exists to warn about, and that warning never printed. "Fail-open by design" degraded to FAIL-SILENT, which is worse than a red because nothing says so.** ❓ **NOT VERIFIED AND UNCLOSEABLE FROM THIS DISK: the droplet’s actual tree and pin were not enumerated — that needs ssh to production, which a fire has no authorization for (F-2299-1’s same boundary).** 🔎 **ATTRIBUTION IS INFERRED, NOT VERIFIED, AND IS MARKED SO DELIBERATELY: rsync at `:175` carries `--timeout=60`, so a pure rsync stall should have returned inside 60 s, and the elapsed ≥2m40s is more consistent with `:176`’s ssh — which has `BatchMode=yes` but NO `ConnectTimeout`, where the `:174` probe has `ConnectTimeout=8`. That is precisely the unbounded hang F-2298-1’s closing note PREDICTED (*"a box that accepts TCP then stalls hangs the deploy unbounded inside a fire’s budget"*) — a banked prediction that has now been observed. But which step hung cannot be proven from this disk.** 🚫 **NO CURE AUTHORED, FOR THREE REASONS, EACH MEASURED RATHER THAN INHERITED.** (1) §7.3 routes deployment acts to the OWNER, and `scripts/deploy.sh` already carries two open desk items (F-2298-1 (b)/(c), F-2299-1 (a)/(b)/(c)). (2) **The obvious observability cure — carry the verified state into the result JSON — REDS A GATE: `scripts/test-deploy-contract.sh:86` asserts the EXACT field set `commit,outcome,publishedBuild,ts,url` and throws `unexpected result fields` on ANY addition.** That is a CONTRACT, not a mirror (read it before touching it), so the cure is a two-file change to a gated contract plus a new case for the trap path — which today has NONE — and not a drive-by.
